Hi Anika — great to hear, and appreciate the requirements doc.

Short answers up front:
- Start on Hosted for the kickoff (faster onboarding) but we should plan a Dedicated run for the load test day if you want strict SLA-like consistency. We can spin a short-term Dedicated pool for the test.
- For a 2-week POC with routing + load tests: request an initial token budget of 250M tokens and a baseline rate limit of 60 QPS with a burst allowance to 150 QPS for scheduled load tests. We'll coordinate a temporary quota bump for the load test window.

I've attached a draft agenda (POC-Agenda-v1.pdf). Please review and tell us which kickoff window works.

Proposed agenda highlights (45–75 min):
- Intros & goals (10)
- Architecture and routing walkthrough (15)
- Prompt review + evaluation criteria (15)
- Quick load-test plan & Dedicated vs Hosted tradeoffs (10)
- Next steps & action items (10)

I'll loop in Marcus for the Dedicated sizing and network details.

Cheers,

Irene / Ben,

Notes after quick review:
- Dedicated pool for a single day load test is feasible. For target burst 150 QPS and sustained 60 QPS, recommended minimal config: 4 x A10-equivalent GPUs (quantized Llama/Redwood-optimized kernels) with autoscale headroom of +50% for unexpected spikes.
- Token budget: 250M is reasonable for two weeks if the workload has average context lengths <1k tokens and you reuse KV cache. For conservative planning bump to 350M if they plan many >1k prompts.
- Network: attaching a short checklist with expected ports and egress rules.

Attachment: network-requirements.xlsx (xlsx)
